newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Normandy no plan on magnesium funding.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Normandy no plan on magnesium funding.

text.p: Normandy Mining Ltd said on Thursday it had no plans yet for the funding of a planned A$700 million magnesium metal project in Queensland.

"That's two to 2-1/2 half years away. We have a lot more things to get through before we get to that stage," a Normandy spokesman told Reuters. "But there could be opportunities for other groups to get involved," the spokesman said.
He said Normandy and project partner Queensland Metals Corp might seek bank-syndicated project financing.

Normandy said Ford Motor Co and the government-owned Commonwealth Scientific Industrial Research Organisation (CSIRO) would contribute financially to the Magmetal development as non-equity partners, along with marketing and technical input.
The 90,000 tonne per annum plant to be built in Gladstone Queensland, 160 km from QMC's Kunwarara magnesite desposit.
Fluor Daniel Inc will design and construct the commercial project and could earn up to a 10 percent interest which would reduce Normandy's and QMC interest to about 45 percent each, Normandy said.
